spans.text: Three hours later. Griffin Control in Area S05.
Are we still in direct confrontation, Commander?!
Sangvis units keep pouring in and I'm almost overwhelmed here distributing supplies on the backline...
If this goes on... I don't know how long the detention center can hold...
...Click.
Comms system received an encrypted call.
...Call accepted.
Commander... Hi, this is Persica...
It's an emergency, so I'm using an encrypted channel just to be safe...
16LAB has been closely monitoring the AR Team and what's befalling the detention center...
This isn't just a random attack. There is an ulterior motive...
So...I've dispatched a T-Doll to aid you...
I'm leaving the rest to you, RO...
Greetings, Commander. I'm a Tactical Doll newly developed by 16LAB, designation RO635.
Long story short, Commander, I have important information to relay.
A Sangvis ringleader has set up a communication outpost in the northeastern valley. I'm sending you its coordinates. Please destroy it as soon as possible.
That will prevent the enemy from getting reinforcements and expediate my arrival.
Is your source credible? You're new to Area S05 yourself, aren't you?
Not to mention you're a completely green rookie...
I'm not a rookie, Miss Kalin.
Moreover, I was developed specifically to tackle such circumstances.
Please have faith in Miss Persica, if nothing else...
What do you think, Commander?
I do agree that Miss Persica won't have us take unnecessary risks.
It's not a good idea to keep up this impasse either. Let's give it a shot while we can still afford to divert our forces!
Thank you for your trust, Commander.
Now please deploy your troops and launch an attack on these coordinates.
